howItWorksText: Our Provably Fair system uses several parameters to ensure complete transparency and fairness. Each round has both hidden and revealed states.
everyRoundUses: Every round uses these four elements:
serverKeyText: Random string generated by the server
crashPointText: The multiplier where the round crashes
provablyFairHashText: SHA-512 hash of the combined data
provablyFairHashFormula: Provably Fair Hash = SHA512(ServerKey + "." + CrashPoint + "." + RoundNumber)
beforeGameBegins: Before the game begins, players can see:
beforeGameBeginsFooter: The Server Key and Crash Point remain hidden to ensure fairness.
onceTheRoundEnds: Once the round completes, all parameters are revealed:
onceTheRoundEndsFooter: The Server Key and Crash Point remain hidden to ensure fairness.
cryptographicHash: A cryptographic hash that proves the round outcome was predetermined
multiplierWhereRoundEnded: The multiplier where the round ended
remainsTheSame: Remains the same, proving nothing changed
maximumWinText: The highest possible multiplier is 25,000x your bet. This is the absolute ceiling—even if the game continues beyond this point (theoretically), your payout caps at 25,000x.
maximumCashOutText: When playing with free bets, a minimum cash-out multiplier applies (typically 1.50x, but configurable). You cannot cash out below this threshold when using promotional free bets.
placingBetsStep1After: using the +/- buttons or preset values (2.00, 5.00, 10.00, Max)
placingBetsStep2After: per round using the left and right betting panels
placingBetsStep3After: (purple button) to confirm your wager for the next comet launch
placingBetsStep5Before: When the comet launches and the multiplier starts rising,
cashingOutStep1After: at any time during the match to secure your winnings
cashingOutStep3: If you place two bets, each has its own cash-out button
cashingOutStep4Before: If you fail to cash out before the comet explodes →
cashingOutStep5: After cashing out, wait until the round ends to bet again
gameInterfaceBalanceDisplayText: Top-right live balance display showing your available funds.
gameInterfaceBettingPanelsText: Two independent betting panels (left and right) allow you to:
gameInterfaceBettingPanelsStep3: Place one or two bets simultaneously
gameInterfaceBettingPanelsStep4: Cancel pending bets before the round starts
gameInterfaceActionButtonsStep1After: Confirm your wager for the next round
gameInterfaceActionButtonsStep2After: Remove a pending bet before the round starts
gameInterfaceActionButtonsStep3After: Collect your winnings during an active round
gameInterfaceActionButtonsStep4After: Double your current bet amount instantly
advancedFeaturesStopConditionsStep1Highl: End autoplay once total profit passes your limit
advancedFeaturesStopConditionsStep2Highl: End autoplay once total loss exceeds your limit
advancedFeaturesStopConditionsStep3Highl: Stop after any bet wins above a certain amount
advancedFeaturesListRoundBetsStep4: Who cashed out and who is still riding the comet
advancedFeaturesListHistoryStep2After: What multiplier you cashed out at (or crash point if you lost)
advancedFeaturesListHistoryStep7After: Reference number for each game round
advancedFeaturesListHistoryChartsViewTex: Graphical display of past comet explosion multipliers useful for reading volatility and patterns.
advancedFeaturesListListViewText: A compact list of recent crash points in chronological order.
advancedFeaturesListCurrentRoundBetsText: Real-time display of all active bets from players currently in the match:
advancedFeaturesListCurrentRoundBetsFoot: Adds transparency, social interaction, and competitive excitement.
advancedFeaturesListMyHistoryFooter: Filter and sort your history to track performance, review strategies, and monitor your bankroll management.
recentMultipliersText: Shows the last exploded comet multipliers. Use this history to observe trends and guess when the next crash may occur.
autoBetText: Enable automatic betting by turning on the Auto switch. The system will place your chosen bet amount automatically each round without manual input.
autoCashOutText: Set a multiplier at which your bet will automatically cash out. This allows you to secure profits without needing to manually click the cash-out button.
autoplayConfigurationText: Use Advanced autoplay settings for hands-free gameplay:
